message: 理想と現実
I take a leisurely stroll while thinking about events for the Holy Night Festival.
Apparently, good ideas come to people when they're taking a casual walk, soaking in the bath, or riding a bicycle.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm in trouble. Nothing's coming to me at all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're overthinking it, Lord Synn. Sure, you're walking slow, but your mind ain't relaxed at all, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh...! Relax, relax, relax. I'm just taking a chill stroll all the way to the residential area!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You look completely desperate to me, y'know?」
The success of the KiraFes was achieved not only through the students, but also thanks to the cooperation of the people of Ryuusei Town, starting with the Shiokumi Shopping District.
So, for the Holy Night Festival too--

name: Melphas
message: 「My sincerest apologies. Never did I imagine things would turn out like that...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's totally fine~ Having the tub covered in flower petals made it suuuper hot, too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, I knew it, some ideals are best left as ideals to admire from afar!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh, to offer me such words of comfort--what kind-hearted maidens you are!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, and who might this be?」
I feel like I've met him somewhere before...

name: Melphas
message: 「A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am a wandering gentleman, and my name is Melphas.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hi there, very polite of you. I'm Synn Sakura, the Ryuusei Academy Student Council President.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Hoho, so you are the Student Council President.」
Beside me, Paqy clicked his tongue, muttering about what a pretentious guy he was.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay, it's Synn-kun. Perfect timing~ Look at me, look at me~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh-la-la, uh-huh\s07 How do I look~? It's the scent of a femme fatale~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, hey, don't go hitting on Synn!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Less 'femme fatale' and more... *sniff, sniff*... smells like a toilet air freshener to me?」

name: Melphas
message: 「It is only natural. A mere plushie could never comprehend the noble fragrance of autumn roses.」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's a faint whiff of chlorine mixed in there, too! Hey, is this what Mr. Pretentious calls 'noble'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, seriously, chlorine? Did I not rinse off enough? *sniff, sniff*」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe, that's probably meee. I got so mesmerized by Nana-chan's naked body that I forgot to rinse off first」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't get mesmerized!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「...*blush*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't blush!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. So you all went to the public bathhouse together?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet we did, and we got the very first bath!」

name: Melphas
message: 「I merely prepared the rose bath. I did not bathe myself, you know. After all, I could hardly intrude upon the women's bath」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just go in the men's bath」

name: Melphas
message: 「Such an action goes against my aesthetic sensibilities」

name: Synn
message: 「Was there even a bathhouse like 'Bara no Yu' in Ryuusei Town?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm telling you, that's not it. I mean a bath with tons of rose petals floating in the tub」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know? Don't people say good ideas come to you when you're soaking in the bath?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So like, we figured if we were gonna do it anyway, we'd get into a huge public bath and brainstorm for the Holy Night Festival」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin? The way you're putting it... don't tell me you couldn't think of anything?」

name: Melphas
message: 「I-I merely wished for two young maidens such as yourselves to enjoy a rose bath. I never intended to ruin your moment of contemplation」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know, I know. We're the ones who asked you to do it, Melphas」

name: Sacchin
message: 「In movies and stuff, lovers get into bathtubs with flower petals floating in them, right? I've always dreamed of doing that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, actually going through with it turned out to be pretty rough, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Why? Doesn't that sound like a super luxurious bath?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm, well, the surface of the water was completely packed with bright red petals, see」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And since they were bobbing up and down, the whole giant tub looked like the insides of some weird creature, throbbing thump-thump, thump-thump」

name: Paqy
message: 「Stop it with the gross metaphors! You just burned a vivid image into the back of my mind!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And sooo, the rose petals would just clog up the drain right awayyy」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know how when you scrape your knee, because it's on a joint, the scab cracks and gets all flappyyy?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It was just like that, with all the petals piled up and dried out in the corner of the washing areaaa」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaaah, please, Sacchin, don't use such a vivid comparison!」

name: Melphas
message: 「You there, Student Council President. I had no intention of causing trouble for Lady Nanaka and Lady Sachiho.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Rather, I would like you to understand the hardships I endured as well.」
From what I've heard, Melphas can summon a flurry of rose petals at will. And yet--

name: Melphas
message: 「Regrettably, that is not the case.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Rose petals only materialize as an afterglow of magical power when I vanish via teleportation.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really?」

name: Melphas
message: 「It was quite the ordeal. Before the bathhouse opened, I pitched a rose bath to the attendant, got formal permission, and entered the empty women's bath alone.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Then, I teleported over to the men's bath, but since the amount of petals was insufficient, I went back outside once, and once again (et cetera)」

name: Melphas
message: 「Out to the entrance yet again, past the attendant's desk, into the women's bath, teleporting over to the men's bath, and yet again and again--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your 'quite the ordeal' is just a synonym for 'a huge pain in the ass'!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How surreal...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Melphas, quit grumbling, quit grumbling! We actually had a blast.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeahhh, it was funnn. Having a little bit of trouble makes things way more exciting anywayyy」

name: Synn
message: 「That might actually give us a hint for the Holy Night Festival!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well done, Sacchin. I bestow upon you my praise!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Honyaaa?」

name: Melphas
message: 「If I was ultimately able to be of service to the maidens, then I am glad.」

name: Melphas
message: 「However... if my memory serves me correctly, the admission fee for a public bathhouse used to equal the price of a bowl of ramen. When did the prices go up?」

name: Synn
message: 「Melphas is surprisingly down-to-earth... though I'm not really one to talk」

name: Melphas
message: 「The Human World is constantly changing; it truly never ceases to fascinate me」

name: Melphas
message: 「May this world exist for all eternity... Now then, please excuse me」
Melphas vanished in a swirling flurry of rose petals.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!? A petal got inside my clothes」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Waaah, ptui, ptui, ptui! One got right inside my mouth!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Don't go littering this stuff all over a public road!」

name: Melphas
message: 「My, how embarrassing. Miss Nanaka, brimming with civic virtue as she is, is quite right」

name: Melphas
message: 「I shall sweep it clean right away」
Seeing Melphas start cleaning up with a portable broom and dustpan in hand, I feel a sudden sense of kinship.
Nanaka and Sacchin, having thoroughly enjoyed their rose bath, surely feel the same.
Humans and Demons can understand each other.
Re-Crea is, so to speak, just a bit of trouble. Once it's resolved, won't both sides be able to bond even more deeply?
